findings.problem: The plan requires an added directory at a review-record filename to be “listed on its own line,” but its stated non-goal forbids changes to `acknowledgement.differences`. That function currently excludes unbaselined directories from its comparison scope, so such a newly added directory produces no `Difference` for `acknowledge.py` to render. The planned classifier cannot make it appear.
findings.suggestion: Either include added directories in `acknowledgement.differences` and revise the non-goal/scope accordingly, or narrow the criterion to directories replacing an existing baselined file and document that newly added directories remain outside the acknowledgement list.

summary: The plan has one implementation-level contradiction concerning newly added directories; otherwise its proposed review-record pattern matches the review engine’s current naming rules.
